run_parallel_model_averaging: run model averaging configurations in parallel across multiple GPUs using multiprocessing
execute_task_on_gpu: execute a single model averaging task on specified GPU with CUDA device isolation
create_TaskResult: create a TaskResult dataclass to store task execution outcomes including success status and GPU indices
detect_available_gpus: detect available GPU count using NVML for automatic GPU assignment in parallel runs
calculate_gpu_utilization: calculate GPU utilization percentage based on total execution time versus theoretical maximum parallel time
